# Mohamed Fat-hy

> Software engineer, 5+ years. Builds mobile apps, web platforms, and the
> backends behind them, end to end, as a single accountable contractor.
> Based in Egypt (GMT+2/+3). Works with clients internationally.
> Site: https://fat-hy.com — Agency: https://agentech.tech

## What he does

Plain description: builds apps and the systems that run them — the phone app,
the website, and the server behind them, delivered by one person start to
finish.

The same work, in industry terms: generative-AI feature integration and
RAG-based assistants, SaaS platform and MVP development, full-stack delivery,
backend engineering, cross-platform mobile development, cloud deployment,
performance and scaling work, and technical audits or legacy takeover.

Current direction: AI-integrated SaaS. He has shipped production AI rather
than demos — a multi-tenant RAG platform with database- and vector-level
tenant isolation and citation-grounded answers, plus AI features inside
client products including 3arabawy and GuruHub — and builds the surrounding
product (mobile app, web app, backend, admin) himself, so an AI feature
arrives inside a working product rather than as a prototype needing a team to
finish it.

## Engagements

- **Scoping Week** (1 week, paid) — also called a discovery sprint or
  technical scoping. Produces a written build plan: scope, ordered feature
  list, staged timeline, per-stage pricing, and named risks. The plan is the
  client's to keep and is portable to any developer. Fee credited against the
  first stage if the project proceeds.
- **First Working Version** (6–8 weeks) — also called an MVP or v1 launch.
  Ships a live product: mobile app on the App Store and Google Play and/or a
  web app, plus backend, database, and an admin interface.
- **Fix or Finish What You Have** (2–4 weeks to assess) — also called project
  rescue, technical audit, or legacy takeover. Written assessment of existing
  work, a reasoned repair-versus-rebuild answer, and a staged plan to finish.
- **Make It Handle More Users** — also called scaling, performance
  optimization, or backend modernization. Measured bottleneck analysis,
  applied fixes with before/after measurement, cost reduction, and monitoring.

## How he prices

Milestone-based. Each stage is fixed-price and agreed before it starts; no
open-ended billing and no full payment upfront. Scope changes are agreed
before they are made. Source code and IP belong to the client from day one and
live in the client's own accounts. No single headline price is published,
because a fair figure depends on scope — the Scoping Week is the intended way
to establish it.

## Technical stack

- AI: Spring AI, LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG),
  embeddings and semantic search, Qdrant vector database, AI chatbots and
  agents grounded in a customer's own data, multi-tenant AI SaaS
- Backend: Spring Boot (Java), .NET (C#). JavaScript backend work has been
  serverless Cloud Functions (Node.js) specifically, not standalone Node
  services.
- Data: PostgreSQL and SQL generally, NoSQL, Firebase, vector stores;
  schema design and Row-Level Security
- Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript
- Mobile: Flutter, Dart — one codebase for iOS and Android; offline-capable
- Practice: Clean Architecture, REST API design, staging/production
  environments, observability

## Delivery record

15+ projects delivered across 10 markets on four continents: Egypt, Saudi
Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Iraq, Kyrgyzstan, South Korea,
Nigeria, the United States, and the European Union.

Clients have returned for repeat engagements — more than one has hired him for
a second project after the first shipped.

The eight products below are the documented case studies. The remainder are
MVPs that did not reach market, proofs of concept, and private commercial work
under confidentiality; Mohamed will discuss any of them directly on a call.

- GuruHub — learning management platform (LMS): offline courses, anti-cheat
  randomized quizzes, four commercial tiers, English + Arabic with RTL.
  Ships AI features.
- Agentech Assistant — multi-tenant RAG chatbot platform (AI as a service)
- 3arabawy — automotive marketplace and service platform (Egypt); 50,000+
  Android installs. Ships AI features.
- MDone — medical booking and telehealth platform (Iraq)
- Toltura — specialist discovery marketplace (Kyrgyzstan)
- BizNavi — corporate HR management platform (South Korea)
- Party Player — music and media streaming app (USA)
- Installment App — merchant installment payment utility (Egypt, fintech)

## Working with him

- Languages: English, Arabic
- Timezone: GMT+2 / GMT+3 — full overlap with Europe, Middle East, most of
  Asia; mornings with US East Coast
- Cadence: weekly demo call, asynchronous written updates between; replies
  within 24 hours on working days
- Capacity: one to two projects at a time
- Will sign a mutual NDA before scope discussions
- Clients can stop between stages and keep everything delivered so far
- Non-technical clients are explicitly welcome; explanations are given in
  plain language

## Not a fit when

Scope changes weekly; a single fixed total price is required before any
assessment; or the deciding factor is lowest cost.
